title: FixRide – Online Vehicle Repair & Service Booking Platform
description: Designed and developed a responsive web application that enables users to browse vehicle repair services and initiate service requests through a clean, user-friendly interface. Focused on frontend usability and deployment workflow.

title: AR Treasure Hunt – Mobile Augmented Reality Game
description: Developed an interactive augmented reality treasure hunt game with five progressive levels using Unity and Vuforia. Implemented marker-based AR object detection, level progression mechanics, and interactive UI systems. Built physics-based gameplay elements and optimized performance for Android mobile devices.

title: SpeedyBlitz – 2D Endless Runner Game
description: Built a productivity tracking system with both command-line and web interfaces to help students manage tasks, track progress, and store data persistently using a lightweight database.
